title: The desk, from behind
logline: The motel's night desk from the office door behind it: the clerk's back in the maroon polo, the pad under his hand, the glass door and the dark lot beyond him. The hum line not drawn. He's in the room this time; the page just won't go around him.

panels.composition: The motel office from the back door: a man's back in a maroon polo at the desk, a pad under his hand, the bell beside it, the glass front door beyond with the sodium-lit lot. No line beneath the page.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a motel night desk seen from the office's back door with a man's back in a maroon polo bent over a pad, a bell beside it, the glass front door and an orange-lit lot beyond, no line beneath the page, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: From behind, at the desk. No hum line in the private pages but once.
